command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== OPENER ==='; f="$HOME/.local/bin/free-frank-open"; [ -f "$f" ] && { stat -c '%A %a %U:%G %s %n' "$f"; sed -n '1,260p' "$f"; } || echo MISSING
echo '=== DESKTOP ==='; sed -n '1,120p' "$HOME/.local/share/applications/free-pool-harness.desktop" 2>/dev/null || true
echo '=== COOLRETRO ==='; command -v cool-retro-term || true
echo '=== SETTINGS PATHS ==='; find "$HOME/.config" "$HOME/.local/share" -maxdepth 5 -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei '(cool.?retro|swordfish)' | sort | head -80
echo '=== TEXT SETTINGS ==='; while IFS= read -r x; do case "$x" in *.png|*.jpg|*.jpeg|*.ico|*.db|*.sqlite*) continue;; esac; echo ---"$x"; sed -n '1,260p' "$x" 2>/dev/null || true; done < <(find "$HOME/.config" "$HOME/.local/share" -maxdepth 5 -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei '(cool.?retro|swordfish)' | sort | head -40)
